title: B2B Influencer Marketing Strategy: Complete Playbook for Measurable Pipeline Growth
summary: Build an effective B2B influencer marketing strategy. Learn how to discover niche authorities on LinkedIn, evaluate agencies vs. Favikon, and measure pipeline.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### Who are the top B2B influencers?


Top B2B influencers are respected practitioners, analysts, operators, educators, and subject-matter experts with proven knowledge in a defined field. Strong candidates show original analysis, practical experience, thoughtful discussions, and an audience that includes relevant buyers or technical decision-makers. Follower count alone is not a reliable measure of influence.


### What is the rule of 7 in B2B marketing?


The rule of 7 in B2B marketing suggests that prospects may need several meaningful brand interactions before taking action. B2B influencer marketing can support this process through repeated exposure across LinkedIn posts, podcasts, newsletters, webinars, and events. Each interaction should offer useful expertise rather than repeated product promotion.


### How much do B2B marketers make?


B2B marketer salaries vary by role, experience, location, company size, and specialty, with managers and directors generally earning more than entry-level professionals. Demand generation, product marketing, marketing operations, and influencer program roles may have different compensation ranges. Candidates should compare base pay, bonuses, equity, and benefits.


### What is the 5-3-2 rule on Instagram marketing?


The 5-3-2 rule on Instagram marketing recommends sharing five pieces of relevant content, three pieces from trusted sources, and two personal or brand updates within a ten-post cycle. The principle promotes a balanced feed instead of constant self-promotion. B2B teams can adapt it across LinkedIn, newsletters, and other professional channels.


### How many times a week should a company post on Instagram?


A company should generally post on Instagram three to five times per week, then adjust based on audience response and available resources. Consistent quality matters more than publishing at a fixed volume. B2B brands should prioritize useful education, customer questions, practitioner insight, and content formats that match how their audience researches solutions.


### How can companies measure B2B influencer marketing success?


Companies can measure B2B influencer marketing through qualified conversations, account engagement, registrations, referrals, consultation requests, and pipeline contribution. Track each creator, audience segment, content format, and conversion path with consistent reporting. Sales feedback and buyer language also show whether creator content is helping prospects evaluate a solution.


### How should a company vet a B2B influencer before partnering?


A company should vet a B2B influencer by reviewing expertise, audience fit, professional history, content quality, engagement depth, and potential conflicts of interest. Examine several months of posts, comments, events, and published work rather than relying on follower totals. The best partner can explain real operating decisions and support informed buyer conversations.
